notes:
Login screen and status-color polish:

• Login screen no longer stretches into a huge empty void on wide/maximized windows — the split panel is now capped and centered.
• Fixed password/confirm-password fields showing a redundant dot placeholder.
• Retuned the status-badge palette (Ready, Missing, GST Mismatch, Duplicate, Warning, Error, Imported) to sit with the app's navy/gold brand instead of generic template pastels — and fixed "GST Mismatch" and "Error" (and "Missing"/"Warning") having near-identical colors that made two different outcomes hard to tell apart at a glance.
